summary: Frontend testing of User Management and Personnel Management sorting + form changes. All 5 requested features verified working correctly.

test_results.user_mgmt_sort_by_rank_then_lastname: PASS - Users show Captain -> Lieutenant -> Firefighter groups. Within Firefighter, alphabetical order by last name confirmed (Castillo, Contact, FF, Firefighter, Sam, Smith, Update, User, User, User, Zebra).
test_results.user_mgmt_first_last_name_fields: PASS - Add User dialog has separate first-name-input and last-name-input testids. No single 'Full Name' field. Edit dialog also has both.
test_results.user_mgmt_test_zebra_creation: PASS - Created user 'Test Zebra' (payroll 999123). Appears as the LAST firefighter in the sorted list (position 16 of 16 Firefighters).
test_results.personnel_mgmt_sort_by_rank_then_lastnam: PASS - In sta-10-B group: Lieutenant -> Paramedic (Gonzalez, Meza) -> Firefighter (Castillo, Lane, Ross). Rank order and alphabetical last-name order correct.
test_results.personnel_mgmt_user_dropdown: PASS - Add Personnel dialog shows 'Select from Users' dropdown (data-testid=user-select) at the top with search input and 'Or enter details manually:' divider below.

critical_code_review_comments: UserManagementPage rankOrder missing entries for ranks that exist in DB: 'Chief', 'Volunteer', 'Part-Time Firefighter', 'Part-Time Paramedic'. These all fall back to 999 and sort to the bottom, causing 'Admin User' (rank='Chief') to be grouped near volunteers/part-time users instead of at the top. Consider aliasing 'Chief' -> 'Fire Chief' or adding all rank variants.
PersonnelManagementPage rankOrder differs slightly from UserManagementPage (Engineer=8 vs 7, Driver Operator=7 vs 8). Extract to a shared constant to keep them consistent.
getLastName splits on space; names like 'Captain Mike Johnson' treat 'Johnson' as last name correctly but names like a single 'Sam' fall back to full string. Acceptable but note edge case.
Test user 'Test Zebra' (payroll 999123) was created during testing; consider seeding cleanup or main agent can leave for future regression.
seed_data_creation: Created test user 'Test Zebra' with payroll_number=999123, password=testpass123 for sort verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 review-request features verified via Playwright at /tools/users and /tools/personnel. Only minor code-review suggestion: unify rankOrder mapping and add missing rank aliases (Chief, Volunteer, Part-Time variants) so they don't all collapse to 999.
